title: N3W YORKERS SPACE PROGRAM
toast: WASD to walk. Shift to hurry. SPACE jumps where gravity allows. Click anything. 1 to 8 jumps rooms. K to skate.
eggline: Every egg in the program found. Mission accomplished. The lease is still up.
hooks: POV: the city started a space program to get out of a lease
the countdown only runs when nobody is looking at it
the capsule is a subway car and gravity is off
alternate side parking on the moon
the bodega on mars answers three seconds late
a two billion dollar telescope pointed at a courtyard
whisper into the dish and astoria answers
the ferry did not stop for the splashdown
